newsitem.title: PERU: Peru's October iron output falls 84.6 percent.
newsitem.headline: Peru's October iron output falls 84.6 percent.

text.p: Peru's iron output fell 84.6 percent to 181,451 tonnes in October, compared with the same month last year, according to preliminary figures from the Energy and Mines Ministry released Monday.
Production fell 28.30 percent to 3.47 million tonnes in the first ten months of the year, compared with the same period last year, the ministry said.

Peru's only iron miner is Chinese-owned Shougang Hierro Peru S.A, a former state-owned firm privatized in November 1992. Analysts say a series of strikes by Shougang workers earlier this year affected production.
Total output of Peruvian iron dropped 14.33 percent last year to 3.897 million tons compared with 4.549 million tons in 1994.
